description.value: A well-equipped 66-site BC Parks campground on the shores of Meziadin Lake at the Cassiar Highway junction, with potable water, washrooms, and e-bike charging — a natural anchor for cyclists on the Cassiar corridor. Summer season only; expect a scenic mountain-lake setting and a genuine rest rather than a rushed stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is OSM tags since the website prefetch returned only BC Parks navigation menus with no park-specific amenity content. OSM provides explicit negative evidence for showers (shower=no) and dump station (sanitary_dump_station=no), and positive evidence for drinking water, toilets, tent camping, and reservations. The URL resolves to the BC Parks provincial park page, confirming this is a legitimate, formal BC Parks campground on the Cassiar Highway corridor.
concerns: Website prefetch returned only navigation menus; no park-specific amenity details could be confirmed from the website, so most amenities rely solely on OSM tags.
Toilet type (flush vs. pit/outhouse) cannot be determined from available evidence.
OSM reports power_supply=yes and internet_access=wlan but neither could be confirmed from website content; these are likely RV electrical hookups, not general-use device charging.
Operator contact is a personal Telus email (marvin_reid@telus.net), suggesting a private contractor arrangement; this may change seasonally.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, formal BC Parks provincial campground on the Cassiar Highway confirmed via the BC Parks website. Essential stop for cyclists in a remote corridor with few alternatives.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM capacity tags indicate 66 total sites with 59 caravan/RV sites and tent camping available. No dump station per OSM (sanitary_dump_station=no). Mobile reception reported present (OSM: mobile_reception=yes), notable given the remote location.

wow_evidence: e-bike charging — a natural anchor for cyclists on the Cassiar corridor
